purpose: Provider-free requalification of the corrected Content Factory after Confirmation Pilot #16 and PR #227 changed generated-output and durable-reuse quality assumptions. This record does not itself restore paid-pilot eligibility; a separate governed qualification-status transition remains required.

qualificationDefectFoundDuringRequalific.finding: The initial Pilot #16 remediation used a generic post-generation script cleaner that could delete legitimate target-language text and an exact cash-flow phrase repair that was too Business-shaped for a generic worker boundary.
qualificationDefectFoundDuringRequalific.resolution: Replace both mutations with course-agnostic generation guardrails: preserve legitimate target-language or prescribed-text wording, reject unrelated contamination through generation/review rather than blind deletion, and require prompt/expected-response presupposition consistency without naming a Business-specific condition. Advance Learn and Practice durable semantic versions so pre-change outputs cannot be reused across the correction.

Q3-subject-shape-matrix.crossSubjectRegression: The language/prescribed-text shape is complemented by a direct live-adapter contract regression proving that legitimate non-Latin target-language text is preserved.

Q5-restart-reuse-dependency-invalidation.invalidationRule: Pre-v2 Learn/Practice outputs are not dependency-compatible with the course-agnostic guardrail contract. Unrelated identity, source, coverage and independent assessment-generation work remains reusable where its dependency closure is unchanged.

limitations: Provider-free reliability requalification proves process and contract behaviour, not factual or educational correctness.
The requalification does not prove live external-provider behaviour or awarding-body endorsement.
The global qualification record remains paused and the live-pilot preflight must continue to fail before any external model call.
